result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with zero stock. The full suite passes offline (608 tests, 0 failures), including a new regression test.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (`findStockLevelsByWarehouse`, ~line 2107): added `AND s.quantity > 0` to the query, the same filter the per-category stock query already uses. I also changed its doc comment, which said zero quantities were included on purpose.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`**: added `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNothingLeft`. It takes all nuts out of WH-1, sets screws to 0, and checks that the list shows only "Bolt 10" and that the nut quantity is still 0.

`StockService.getQuantity` and the below-threshold listing are unchanged, so a product with no stock still reports 0 and still appears in the low-stock list. Nothing is committed.
